capabilities: store secrets in KeePass v3/v4 (.kdbx) databases inside the vault
insert {{vc:...}} tokens that render as masked chips in Live Preview and Reading mode
copy secret values to the clipboard with a configurable auto-clear timeout
lock and unlock profiles per session with auto-lock timers
create and edit KeePass entries through plugin settings and editor commands
disambiguation: It does not encrypt notes or the vault itself; notes stay plaintext and only referenced secret values live in a .kdbx database.
extras: No network calls and no vault contents in settings or logs, per the README security section.
problem: Obsidian notes are plain Markdown files, so writing passwords or API keys directly into notes leaves them exposed in plaintext.

summary: Secret manager that stores values in KeePass-compatible .kdbx databases and inserts masked {{vc:...}} token chips into notes.
